description: Re-architect the 'monitor-stack' Docker Compose project to remove the direct Docker socket mount from the 'monitor' service. 1) Create a new 'proxy' service using nginx:alpine that mounts /var/run/docker.sock and exposes it on port 2375. 2) Configure Nginx to proxy requests to the unix socket but ONLY allow GET requests (deny POST/DELETE/etc). 3) Update the 'monitor' service to remove the socket mount and instead connect to the proxy via TCP (set DOCKER_HOST=tcp://proxy:2375). 4) Ensure the stack is up and running.
